note: DuckDB extensions the Elections app's DuckDB-WASM 1.29.0 (DuckDB v1.1.1) loads at run time: parquet, autoloaded by read_parquet(). Until 11 Nov 2026 the browser fetched them from extensions.duckdb.org; now scripts/build/elections-app/vendor.mjs downloads each from that address, refuses it unless its SHA-256 is the one pinned here (taken from the files served on 11 Nov 2026), and the app reads them from its own copy (custom_extension_repository, site/apps/elections/lib/duck.js). Signed by DuckDB; not modified.
